prose: 404 Media reports that OpenAI lets advertisers target ChatGPT users by email address, phone number or a unique phone identifier, based on its own tests of the ad system. Such targeting is standard in advertising.
The concern is that with about a billion monthly users, many may not realize their contact details can be used to place ads in their sessions.
highlights: ChatGPT ads can target by email, phone number or device ID.
Standard ad practice, but users may not expect it.
